text:
renee: Quick check — launch posts + webinar went out yesterday. Dashboard sessions up but MQLs barely budged. Can we verify attribution before Monday KPI?
dave: Seeing same. Topline traffic looks great but 'utm_source' missing on a lot of sessions.
kai: Ran a small query:
```
select count(*) filter (where utm_source is null) as missing, count(*) as total from sessions where occurred_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
```
missing = 4,200 / total = 16,000 (~26%).
jordana: We used short.link for social promos. I swapped the redirect template last minute to speed routing — might be stripping query params.
ops-bot: shortener-service deployed (sha: e1f2) at 11:02 UTC — config preserve_qs=false.
renee: That would do it. Action items: 1) jordana flip preserve_qs=true and redeploy, 2) kai backfill using click logs, 3) add unattributed metric to KPI dashboard.
jordana: Pushed hotfix, PR: https://git.company/shortener/pull/428 — setting preserve_qs=true. Rolling now.
kai: Starting backfill job (id: backfill-31876). Expect ~65% match from linker logs. Will output CSV to /reports/launch_backfill.csv. ETA 4h.
dave: Add a small widget: "unattributed %" and set alert if >20%. CEO asked to see that tile.
kai: Will add derived metric and alert. Also uploading a pre-backfill snapshot: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3187654321_pre.png
ops-bot: PR merged and rolled to canary. No errors.
kai: Backfill complete: matched 2,700 of 4,200 (~64%). Adjusted MQLs +1.9pp. Post-backfill snapshot: https://app.company/dashboards/kpi/snapshots/3187654321_post.png
dave: Good recovery. We'll include a short note in the weekly KPI deck explaining the tracking regression and the fix.
renee: Thanks team. Leaving this thread as single source for updates. If unattributed rate >20% again, escalate to eng oncall. :thumbsup:
